subject: Rebaseline POC scope - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <mcole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dpatel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + next steps from our discovery call

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned going into the POC:

Summary of needs:
- Two primary evaluation flows: 1) customer support response summarization (latency sensitive), 2) internal search re-ranking for docs (throughput sensitive).
- Data residency: logs cannot leave AWS us-west-2.
- Success criteria: 90th pct latency < 600ms for single-turn summary at 512 tokens; reranking MRR uplift > 8% vs current baseline.
- Stakeholders: you (AI platforms), Procurement (contracts), CS (post-POC handoff).

Proposed POC plan / timeline (high level):
- Week 1: access + sample data ingest, baseline runs with Redwood hosted model variants
- Week 2: config tuning (batching/quantization), targeted eval runs, measure latency & MRR
- Week 3: lock success criteria, handoff to CS for expansion plan

Ownership: Redwood (Marissa, Dev) to deliver infra and SOW; Acme to provide sample dataset and two eval prompts per flow.

Attachments: I attached the initial SOW and an evaluation-criteria spreadsheet for your review.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm the success criteria above and that AWS us-west-2 is acceptable for the POC?
2) If yes, can Procurement expect an SOW for signature by end of next week?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
mcole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123


From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <mcole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from our discovery call

Thanks Marissa — this is a helpful recap. A couple of notes and a request to adjust scope mid-trial: 

1) Success criteria: the latency target looks reasonable; we'd prefer 75th pct < 500ms if possible, but we can keep 90th < 600ms as the minimum pass. For reranking, 8% MRR uplift is our target.

2) Data residency: us-west-2 is fine.

3) Mid-trial scope change request: After talking to our CS team, we'd like to add a short "summarize + extraction" use case (structured extraction of entities from support transcripts) to the POC. It adds two evaluation prompts and expected extraction precision > 85%. We understand this may affect timeline and want to rebaseline if needed.

Procurement (cc'd) — please review SOW and confirm if a PO or contract signature is needed before we start ingesting sample data.

I'll sync internally and get back on signatures, but please proceed with technical onboarding steps where possible.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Director, AI Platforms
Acme Corp
sarah.lin@acmecorp.com

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 2:23 PM Marissa Cole <mcole@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message clipped]

From: Marissa Cole <mcole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dpatel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from our discovery call

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the quick feedback and the added extraction use case. We can accommodate adding the "summarize + extraction" flow, but it will change the POC acceptance matrix and may push the timeline by ~1 week to allow for labeling and representative extraction checks.

Proposed rebaseline (updated):
- Week 0 (this week): SOW sign (if Procurement requires), secure access, sample data ingestion starts.
- Week 1: Baseline tests for summary and reranking (as originally scoped).
- Week 2: Implement extraction pipeline + run extraction evals. Labeling: Acme provides 100 annotated transcripts OR Redwood provides labeling at additional cost — please confirm preference.
- Week 3: Final evals, measurement against updated success criteria, and handoff.

Updated success criteria (additions in bold):
- Summarization: 90th pct latency < 600ms (goal: 75th < 500ms)
- Reranking: MRR uplift >= 8%
- Extraction: precision >= 85% on the provided annotated set

Attachments: I attached an updated evaluation_criteria_v2.xlsx and an updated SOW (Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf) with an addendum for the extraction flow.

Can Procurement confirm whether a signed SOW is required before data ingest? Also, Sarah — would Acme prefer Redwood to provide the 100 labeled transcripts as a billable add-on, or will your team provide them?

I'll loop Dev and Nikhil on technical constraints once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dpatel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <mcole@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Rebaseline POC scope - Acme Corp

Hi all —

Quick technical notes on the extraction add-on and timeline impact: 
- Extraction model: we can run extraction as a post-processing step on the same generation model (no separate model required), but extraction precision will be sensitive to prompt design and examples.
- Labeling: to reach a reliable precision estimate, 100 labeled transcripts should be enough for an initial check, but stratified examples (edge cases + common cases) will speed iteration. If Acme wants Redwood to label, lead time is ~5 business days and costs are in the SOW addendum.
- Infra: no additional infra required for the POC beyond the original plan; we'll use dedicated tagging in us-west-2 and keep logs within your VPC connector.
- Timeline risk: if labeling is delayed, extraction evals will slip; otherwise rebaseline +1 week is realistic.

I'll prepare a short runbook for the extraction eval and share by EOD tomorrow.

Dev
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dpatel@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <mcole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Updated POC plan, success criteria, and next steps (action items)

Thanks everyone — summarizing the agreed updates and actions so we have a single source of truth: 

Agreed updates:
- Extraction flow added to POC; updated success criteria (precision >= 85%).
- Rebaseline adds one week to the original timeline; tentative end date moves to Week 4 after sign-off.
- All POC infra will run in AWS us-west-2 and logs will remain in your account/VPC connector.

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Acme: confirm whether Redwood should perform labeling (100 transcripts) or if Acme will provide labeled set — due Tue, 23 Jun 2026 (Sarah).
- Procurement: confirm if signed SOW/PO required before data ingest — due Fri, 19 Jun 2026 (Procurement).
- Marissa: issue updated SOW + DocuSign link — sent now (see related_links).
- Dev/Nikhil: share extraction runbook and test plan — due Thu, 18 Jun 2026.
- Rachel (CS): prepare post-POC expansion checklist — due Mon, 29 Jun 2026.

Attachments: Redwood_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (with addendum), evaluation_criteria_v2.xlsx

Please reply here to confirm and we’ll lock the start date once Procurement confirms the signature path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
